ABOUT ME

I enjoy the whole problem, not just the code.

I like understanding how an application fits together: the interface someone sees, the systems working underneath it, and the practical need it is supposed to meet.

My work includes Rasputin, an Electron desktop app for local language models; Geo Graph, a geospatial evidence workspace; and digital forensic investigations using Exterro FTK. I pair technical analysis with documentation and clear explanations for non-technical audiences.
